engine.notes: SAK is the scene; the Orlando Improv and the Funny Bone are stand-up clubs despite the name of the first. Nothing improv-specific could be verified in Winter Park.

entries.name: SAK Comedy Lab
entries.summary: Downtown Orlando's improv institution since 1991, with professional shows every Friday and Saturday at 7 and 9 pm, a four-level SAK University track ending in a graduation show, and alumni including Wayne Brady.
entries.schedule: Shows Fri-Sat 7 and 9 pm; student showcases midweek; free trial classes Oct 11 and 12, 2026
signals: Own venue at 55 W Church St, Suite 211
SAK U Levels 1-4 plus advanced workshops
entries.reasons: Thirty-five years in a permanent downtown home, a levelled school with graduation shows, a weekly professional calendar and national alumni; only the midweek calendar is thinner than the biggest city theaters.

entries.name: The Corner Gallery
entries.summary: Friday-night improv room run with the City of Casselberry at its recreation center, 15 minutes from downtown Orlando, with weekly showcases, visiting teams, musical improv and an eight-week Foundations of Longform class.
entries.schedule: Fridays 7:30-9 pm, $10-$12; next class semester to be announced
signals: Partnership with the City of Casselberry
entries.reasons: A dated weekly calendar and a long-form class in a borrowed civic room; young, one night a week, and the next class semester has no date yet.
